name: FilmAffinity Ratings
description: Fetches FilmAffinity scores for movies and TV series using Wikidata (P480) ID resolution and a configurable external score endpoint (JSON API or FilmAffinity HTML proxy/mirror), writing scores to Jellyfin's native CommunityRating (and optionally CriticRating) and registering clickable FilmAffinity external links.
overview: Display FilmAffinity ratings on movies and TV shows in Jellyfin.
